products.name: Stride Volt Runner
products.shortCopy: Light daily trainer tuned for neighborhood miles.
products.longCopy: The Volt Runner balances cushion and ground feel for easy mileage. Breathable upper, recycled foam midsole, rubber coverage on high-wear paths. Fits true to size; half sizes available.

products.name: Stride Floor Crew Tee
products.shortCopy: Anti-odor tee that survives back-to-back sessions.
products.longCopy: Athletic cut, flat seams, and a weight that layers under a shell. Wicking knit sourced for durability in commercial gyms and home setups alike.

products.name: Stride City Pierce Jacket
products.shortCopy: Wind-resistant shell for dawn commutes and cooldowns.
products.longCopy: Packable hood, reflective hits at shoulder and hem, DWR without crinkle noise. Designed for 40–55°F layering over the Crew Tee.

products.name: Stride HIIT Grip Trainer
products.shortCopy: Lateral support for intervals, sled pushes, and circuits.
products.longCopy: Stable platform, flexible forefoot, and outsole siping that grips stall mats. Not a running shoe—built for mixed conditioning.

products.name: Stride Open Gym Short
products.shortCopy: 7-inch liner short with phone slot that does not bounce.
products.longCopy: Compression liner phone pocket, sweat-wicking shell, and a drawcord that stays tied. Tested on squat days and treadmill finishers.

products.name: Stride Flow Mat 5 mm
products.shortCopy: Grip that holds in humid studios.
products.longCopy: Closed-cell top layer resists moisture; bottom texture limits slide on hardwood. Rolls tight and includes carry strap.

products.name: Stride Rack Gloves Lite
products.shortCopy: Minimal palm padding; full bar feel.
products.longCopy: Synthetic suede palm, mesh back, and integrated wrist wrap optional. Sizing by hand circumference chart on site.

products.name: Stride Stair Pocket Legging
products.shortCopy: Side pocket fits pro phones; no sag at mile five.
products.longCopy: Matte compression fabric with sweat channeling and UPF 40+. High rise stays put on stairs and tempo runs.

products.name: Stride Kick Flat Crew Sock (3-pack)
products.shortCopy: Arch band and cushioned forefoot for daily wear.
products.longCopy: Structured cotton blend with reinforcement in toe and heel. Neutral palette matches Volt and HIIT lines.

products.name: Stride Track Repeats Split Short
products.shortCopy: 3-inch split for turnover days.
products.longCopy: Featherweight shell, brief liner, and reflective logo at hem. Built for workouts under 12K on the oval or roads.

products.name: Stride Road Tempo Singlet
products.shortCopy: Laser-cut armholes to reduce friction on long tempos.
products.longCopy: Race-day weight with everyday durability. Drop tail for coverage; bonded seams at shoulder.

products.name: Stride Sunrise Recovery Hoodie
products.shortCopy: French terry with stretch for post-run coffee runs.
products.longCopy: Kangaroo pocket with hidden zip pouch, three-panel hood, rib that keeps shape after dryer low heat.

products.name: Stride Trail Gate Pack 12L
products.shortCopy: Vest-fit pack for water, poles, and a light shell.
products.longCopy: Front bottle pockets, trekking pole loops, and sternum straps that adjust on the fly. Fits torsos 15–19 inches per size guide.

products.name: Stride Motion Concept Film
products.shortCopy: Brand film: speed, blur, and sound design teaser.
products.longCopy: Use this asset for paid social bumpers and email hero video still. 15s / 6s cutdowns available on Stride Drop channel (demo).
bullets: Replace with brand video in production

products.name: Stride Mountain Ridge Wind Pant
products.shortCopy: Tapered shell with ankle zip for boots or runners.
products.longCopy: Mapped stretch panels at knee; ankle zip clears shoes without removing. PFC-free DWR.

products.name: Stride Group Training 10-Pack
products.shortCopy: Ten drop-in credits for partner studios nationwide (demo).
products.longCopy: Redeem via Stride app; roll unused credits one quarter. Partnership list rotates—prototype copy only.

products.name: Stride Sprint Spike Proto
products.shortCopy: 6-pin plate for 400–1500m.
products.longCopy: Aggressive toe spring with removable pins. Not certified for all federations—check local rules before race day.

products.name: Stride Kettle Kit (12 + 16 kg)
products.shortCopy: Matte powder coat, color-coded handles.
products.longCopy: Flat base for renegade rows; wide handle for two-hand swings. Sold as pair with online start guide PDF.

products.name: Stride Studio Reservation Credit
products.shortCopy: Single studio class credit (demo cities).
products.longCopy: Late cancel policy: refund if >12h. Waitlist auto-enroll via SMS.

products.name: Stride Life Bundle · Volt + Crew + Mat
products.shortCopy: Starter bundle for the new season.
products.longCopy: Includes Volt Runner (one color), Floor Crew Tee (choose size), and Flow Mat. Bundle discount auto-applied at checkout in prototype flows.
